title: "Agility & Robustness: Clojure spec" by Stuart Halloway
summary: Stuart Halloway shows how Clojure's spec library lets you build programs that are both agile and robust. He covers declarative, predicate-based specification layered on interactive REPL development.
why: Cited as an argument for runtime specs as an alternative to static typing, including a comparison of types, tests and spec.

quote.text: He offers a chart that shows the strengths and weaknesses of strict typing versus unit tests versus the run-time checks offered by Spec. It's worth a look.
